diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement line 26 and F1/F2 give X -> X times_S Y by Gamma_u=(id_X,u), X -> Y by u, Y -> Y times_S Y by Delta_{Y/S}, and X times_S Y -> Y times_S Y by H=(u pr_X,pr_Y). Since u is an S-morphism, the two components of H have equal composites to S. Figure placements and arrow directions match these domains/codomains exactly.
F1 says pr_X Gamma_u=id_X and pr_Y Gamma_u=u; hence H Gamma_u=(u,u). F2 gives Delta_{Y/S} u=(u,u). This is precisely proof step 1.1 and the displayed square has these two paths.

For a:T -> X times_S Y and c:T -> Y with Ha=Delta c, step 1.1 gives u a_X=c and a_Y=c. Step 2.1 gives the unique lift a_X:T -> X, satisfying Gamma_u a_X=a and u a_X=c. The caption calls the square Cartesian on exactly this basis, with no separation or reducedness assumption.
The complete original two-step test-map proof is byte-for-byte preserved. The new final Remarks neither supplies a proof premise nor replaces any proof argument.
